session.title: Website session cookies
session.description:
1. Open [Lose It!]({website_url}) in your signed-in browser, then Developer tools → Network and select a Lose It! request.
2. Under Headers → Request Headers, right-click Cookie → Copy value. See the [cookie guide]({guide_url}).
3. Paste below, check your fallback timezone, and submit.

Keep this session private. Paste a one-line Cookie value (optional Cookie: prefix); legacy JSON cookie objects also work. Expired sessions need manual replacement from the same account.

error.invalid_auth: The website session cookies are invalid or expired. Copy your current session cookies using the guide and try again.
error.invalid_input: Paste a one-line Cookie value with liauth or fn_auth, or a legacy JSON cookie object, and enter a valid IANA timezone. Do not paste a full header block or cURL command.
error.rate_limited: The service has rate limited requests. Wait before retrying.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot retrieve supported account data. Try again later; the experimental website protocol may have changed.

abort.wrong_account: Use the same account; the existing credentials were not changed.

error.invalid_timezone: Enter a valid IANA timezone, such as America/Chicago.

init.title: Conservative polling policy
init.description: 30 minutes is our initial integration policy, not a vendor quota. Choose 30–1440 minutes. Manual refresh shares the account cooldown. Individual nutrients can be enabled in the entity registry.
